name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Crumble Cake
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Crumble Cake pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Built on the Crumb Cake strain, Crumble Cake serves up a rich, dessert-forward profile: sweet vanilla cake and warm cinnamon-sugar notes up front, grounded by a smooth, earthy finish. It's an indulgent, bakery-style smoke made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, cozy, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Crumb Cake strain — sweet baked-goods flavor with an earthy backbone
Rich Crumble Cake flavor — vanilla cake and cinnamon sugar with a smooth finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Crumble Cake is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
